name: Python Scale Armor
body:
Aura: moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot: chest; Price: 10,000 gp; Weight: 15 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This armor is made from the scales of huge pythons. It is equivalent to masterwork leather armor, but also gives the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and Intimidate checks, and a +2 enhancement bonus to CMB/CMD when grappling.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells bull’s strength, scare; Cost: 5,000 gp.
